Definition: from G1909 and G242; to spring upon:--leap on.
BiblicalUsage: Ephallomai means to leap upon, to spring on. The man with the evil spirit leaps on the seven sons of Sceva, overcomes them, and prevails against them, so that they flee out of the house naked and wounded.
TheologicalSignificance: Borrowed authority is no authority at all, and the evil one knows the difference — that is the warning of the sons of Sceva.
RelatedEvents: The Sons of Sceva at Ephesus
